catalogsTab.gcpProjectHelp: The project the data products are created in.
catalogsTab.gcpLocationHelp: The Dataplex location, such as us or europe-west1.
catalogsTab.awsRegionHelp: The region of the DataZone domain, such as us-east-1.
catalogsTab.datazoneDomainIdHelp: The domain the data products are published in.
catalogsTab.secretHelp: Stored credentials are never displayed. Leave blank to keep the current one; clear and save to remove it.
catalogsTab.intro: Connect each catalog this organization works with once. The metadata export publishes to these catalogs, and a table's description can be taken from, refreshed from or locked to the catalogs of its domain.
catalogsTab.heading: Catalogs
catalogsTab.noCatalogs: No catalogs yet. Add the catalogs this organization works with.
catalogsTab.catalogIdHelp: A short name for this catalog, unique in the organization (for example openmetadata-prod). Two catalogs may be of the same type.
catalogsTab.domainsHelp: The domains that work with this catalog. Their tables and data products publish to it, and their tables offer it.
